description: This file defines a utility object StringUtils containing methods to join a LinkedList into a string and split a string into a LinkedList, utilizing external utility classes JoinUtils and SplitUtils.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: Utility object providing string manipulation methods involving LinkedList.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a LinkedList into a String using JoinUtils.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a String into a LinkedList using SplitUtils.
